village.name: Leif
dialogue: Mira keeps the seed packets inside the market on Seed Lane. I usually cross the little timber bridge on my way there.
The fountain makes a good meeting place. The post office and cafe are just along the southern lane.

village.name: Alba
dialogue: The fountain makes a good meeting place. The post office and cafe are just along the southern lane.
I am taking the harbour road after lunch. Follow the southern path and keep walking when it reaches the edge.

village.name: Perrin

aster-quay.name: Leif
dialogue: You can fish from the timber piers. Cato sells supplies inside the fishmonger, just above the waterfront.
The canal bridges keep the market and harbour close together. I like the bench beside the water.

aster-quay.name: Alba
dialogue: The canal bridges keep the market and harbour close together. I like the bench beside the water.
Saltwind is east along the road. The cliff trail leads to the vault courtyard; the entrance is up the steps.

aster-quay.name: Perrin
dialogue: Saltwind is east along the road. The cliff trail leads to the vault courtyard; the entrance is up the steps.

sunridge.name: Leif
dialogue: The orchard paths are lovely in the morning. Lyra keeps fresh flowers inside the shop by the western lane.
Ada has food ready in the bakery. I stop there before I take the long trail south.

sunridge.name: Alba
dialogue: Ada has food ready in the bakery. I stop there before I take the long trail south.
Follow the southern road for Ember Trail. You will see the old quarry before reaching the glassworks gate.

sunridge.name: Perrin

briar-hollow.name: Leif
dialogue: The reading garden is beside the archive. Ilan is usually in the library while Jun walks the town lanes.
There is a warm place to rest in the mountain lodge. Tobin has trail supplies inside the outfitters.

briar-hollow.name: Alba
dialogue: There is a warm place to rest in the mountain lodge. Tobin has trail supplies inside the outfitters.
The northern road climbs towards the observatory. There is a sheltered court before the upper entrance.
